## Summary
Implement the faculty approval gate (waitForEvent with 30d timeout) and post-approval processing: atomic CoverageRecord updates and BKT parameter initialization for approved items.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to approve or reject generated items, and have approved items automatically update coverage records and initialize student mastery tracking, so that approved items are immediately available in the practice pool.

## Why this matters
This is a CRITICAL story. C03: If CoverageRecord updates use read-modify-write instead of atomic Cypher SET, concurrent approvals cause undercounting -- the system thinks fewer items cover a SubConcept than actually do, leading to unnecessary re-generation. C10: Without proper rate limiting enforcement at the approval boundary, a compromised or buggy client could approve items beyond quota.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `step.waitForEvent('journey/items.batch-reviewed', { timeout: '30d' })` waits for faculty decision
- [ ] Approved items: status updated to 'approved', approved_at + approved_by set
- [ ] Rejected items: status updated to 'rejected', rejection reason stored
- [ ] CoverageRecord.assessment_count incremented via atomic Cypher SET (Rule 11, C03)
- [ ] NEVER read-modify-write on CoverageRecord (AP-10)
- [ ] Advisory lock acquired before CoverageRecord update (keyed on institution_id + subconcept_id)
- [ ] Advisory lock timeout: 30 seconds
- [ ] BKT parameters initialized for approved items: p_init=0.10, p_transit=0.20, p_slip=0.10, p_guess=0.20
- [ ] Post-approval emits `journey/items.approved` event per approved item
- [ ] Supabase-first dual-write (Rule 6): update Supabase status FIRST, Neo4j SECOND
- [ ] Rate limit validation: verify faculty hasn't exceeded 100/day quota before processing approval
- [ ] All Neo4j writes via neo4jQuery (Rule 1)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for CoverageRecord atomic updates and BKT writes |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Supabase-first: update item status in Supabase BEFORE Neo4j CoverageRecord |
| Rule 11 (C03) | Atomic SET cr.assessment_count = cr.assessment_count + 1 in Cypher |
| AP-10 | BANNED: read count → increment in JS → write back (race condition) |
| C10 | Rate limiting: 3 concurrent/faculty, 100/day quota, cost confirm >10 items |

## Inngest event context
Function: `journey/items.batch-generate`
Step: `step.waitForEvent('journey/items.batch-reviewed', { timeout: '30d' })` -- waits for faculty decision
Step: `step.run('post-approval', ...)` -- processes approval/rejection
Events triggered: `journey/items.approved` per approved item `{ item_id, subconcept_id, slo_id, institution_id }`
Events consumed: `journey/items.batch-reviewed` with `{ batch_id, decisions: [{ item_id, approved: boolean, reason? }] }`
onFailure: Log failure, items remain in 'pending_review' status (safe -- faculty can re-approve)

## API contract
```
POST /api/generation/review
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  batch_id: string,
  decisions: [{ item_id: string, approved: boolean, reason?: string }]
}
Response: { data: { approved_count: number, rejected_count: number }, error: null }
Error: { data: null, error: { code: string, message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/post-approval.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server';

export async function postApproval(
  decisions: ApprovalDecision[],
  institutionId: string
): Promise<PostApprovalResult> {
  const supabase = createServerClient();

  const approved = decisions.filter(d => d.approved);
  const rejected = decisions.filter(d => !d.approved);

  // RULE 6: Supabase FIRST
  for (const item of approved) {
    await supabase
      .from('assessment_items')
      .update({ status: 'approved', approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), approved_by: item.faculty_id })
      .eq('id', item.item_id);
  }

  // RULE 11 (C03): Atomic CoverageRecord increment in Neo4j
  // NEVER read → increment → write back
  const coverageResults = await Promise.allSettled(
    approved.map(item =>
      neo4jQuery(`
        MATCH (cr:CoverageRecord)-[:COVERS]->(sc:SubConcept { uuid: $subconceptId })
        WHERE cr.institution_id = $institutionId
        SET cr.assessment_count = cr.assessment_count + 1,
            cr.updated_at = datetime()
        RETURN cr.assessment_count AS new_count
      `, {
        subconceptId: item.subconcept_id,
        institutionId,
      })
    )
  );

  // BKT initialization (concept_mastery rows created on first student interaction,
  // but template parameters set here)
  // Emit events for approved items
  return { approved: approved.length, rejected: rejected.length };
}
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `UPDATE assessment_items SET status = 'pending_review', approved_at = NULL, approved_by = NULL WHERE status = 'approved' AND approved_at > '[timestamp]';`
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (cr:CoverageRecord) WHERE cr.updated_at > datetime('[timestamp]') SET cr.assessment_count = cr.assessment_count - [approved_count]`
3. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS concept_mastery;`
4. git stash && git checkout develop
